facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse, from self-reported PeeringDB data last updated January 2026, lists ADDIX in Addis Ababa with 3 members (AddIX Technology Solutions, Bank of Abyssinia, WebSprix), 21 Gbps cumulative port capacity, and all 3 peering at the route server.

Wingu Africa states that ADDIX, Ethiopia's first IXP, launched over a year before 4 September 2025 and is operated by ADDIX Technology Solutions under the Ethiopian Communications Authority, hosted at Wingu's data centre in the ICT Park, keeping local traffic in Ethiopia (as_of is the article date, which gives no launch date).

note: Kenya article; mentions IXPs only generically (Somcable virtual peering with Google at major IXPs), no Ethiopian exchange.
Names exchanges only in South Africa, Kenya and Nigeria; nothing on an exchange in Ethiopia.
The sheet says only that ET1 is to host Ethiopia's IXP; no exchange in service is stated.
Mobile coverage story; no exchange point stated.
Safaricom results article; Ethiopia figure is an operator customer count and nothing else this study asks is stated.
Ethiopia is named only as a neighbour of Kenya's land links.
